Source.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/10] We administered the T\u00d7C to the parents and patients after session 1, at the sixth session, and at termination of treatment.

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/10] Treatment credibility (T\u00d7C) is a measure derived from Borkovec and Nau<sup_ref>43</sup_ref> to tap the extent to which patients or parents believe that the specific treatment to which they have been assigned sounds logical, seems likely to be helpful, and is an intervention that they would recommend to a friend.
